description: Na₄Mg(GeSe₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.12 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.16 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-7°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.15 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.05 Å. Mg is bonded to six Se atoms to form MgSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-7°. There are a spread of Mg-Se bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.86 Å. Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and one longer (2.41 Å) Ge-Se bond length. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-85°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-85°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄MgGe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-85°.
